gpu.comment: Baked-in GPU policy — overrides any argv.json or user setting. These flags are applied at Electron bootstrap before window creation.

v8.comment: V8 heap tuning: 8GB old space, 64MB semi-space. Prevents OOM on large workspaces.

process.comment: Per-process V8 limits for extension host and shared process.

crashRecovery.comment: Watchdog monitors extension host health. After 3 crashes/hour, enters safe mode.

startup.comment: WEPET-ER boot protocol: GPU process preloaded, PTY host warmed, non-critical extensions deferred.
